newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INJURED CONTE MAY BE OUT FOR SIX MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURED CONTE MAY BE OUT FOR SIX MONTHS.

text.p: Midfielder Antonio Conte could be out action for up to six months after badly twisting his knee during Italy's 1-0 win over Georgia in a World Cup qualifier, European Champions Juventus said on Thursday.
A spokesman said Conte, 27, was certain to miss the side's European Cup Champions' League Group C tie at Rapid Vienna next Wednesday.
Conte twisted his knee in a clash with a Georgian player in the second half of the game on Wednesday and had to be substituted by Dino Baggio.
He was due to be examined by club doctors on Thursday to determine whether he had also torn cruciate ligaments in his left knee, an injury which would put him out of action for around six months.
The Juventus spokesman said further details of his injury would be known after Thursday's tests.
"We hope it is not that serious," the spokesman said.
